event_name: Date 28 April 2018 Time 17:58 2018 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 April 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Alleged impeding by car 35 on car 9 in turn 7.
offence: Breach of Article 31.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards examined multiple angles of video and the GPS tracking. The separation of the two cars at Turn 7 was not small enough to establish a case for unnecessary impeding in what is the slowest corner on the circuit. It was noted that the driver of car 9 aborted his fast lap out of Turn 7. Garry Connelly Dennis Dean Tom Kristensen Anar Shukurov
rules_referenced: Article 31.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: 2018 Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2018 Decision Car 35 Alleged Impeding Doc 20
